papers.title: AI Methods for Antimicrobial Peptides: Progress and Challenges.
AntiBP3: A Method for Predicting Antibacterial Peptides against Gram-Positive/Negative/Variable Bacteria.
AMPActiPred: A three-stage framework for predicting antibacterial peptides and activity levels with deep forest.
Protease-Resistant, Broad-Spectrum Antimicrobial Peptides with High Antibacterial and Antifungal Activity.

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Random Forest, Extra Trees, Support Vector Classifier using amino acid binary profile of NC-terminal residues
models.input_features: amino acid binary profile of terminal residues, various composition features (AAC, PCP, APAAC, etc.)
models.candidate_reason: Provides a new method for predicting antibacterial peptides against three bacterial groups, with web server, standalone package, and comparison with existing tools.

models.task_type: antibacterial peptide classification and activity prediction
models.architecture_or_algorithm: deep forest (cascading architecture similar to deep neural networks)
models.input_features: multiple effective peptide descriptors capturing compositional features and physicochemical properties
models.candidate_reason: Proposes a three-stage framework for ABP identification and activity prediction, with web server, and claims state-of-the-art performance.
Mentioned in review as an AMP prediction model capable of species-specific antibacterial activity prediction (Level 3/4).

metrics.usage: Area under the ROC curve, used to evaluate AntiBP3 and compare with existing methods
metrics.evidence: Our model ... achieved maximum AUC 0.93, 0.98, and 0.94 for GP, GN, and GV ABPs, respectively.

metrics.usage: Matthews correlation coefficient, reported for AntiBP3
metrics.evidence: MCC of 0.75 for GP ABPs using AAC-based features.

metrics.usage: Overall accuracy reported for AMPActiPred Stage 1
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred focuses on ABP identification, achieving an Accuracy of 87.6% and an MCC of 0.742.

metrics.usage: Geometric mean used for multi-species ABP activity prediction in AMPActiPred
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred achieved an average GMean at 82.8% in identifying ABPs targeting 10 bacterial species.

metrics.usage: Pearson correlation coefficient for activity level prediction in AMPActiPred
metrics.evidence: AMPActiPred demonstrates robust predictive capabilities for ABP activity levels with an average PCC of 0.722.

important_evidence: AntiBP3 achieved AUC 0.93 (GP), 0.98 (GN), 0.94 (GV) using binary profile of terminal residues.
AMPActiPred reached Accuracy 87.6% and MCC 0.742 in ABP identification (Stage 1).
APEX mentioned in a 2025 review as predicting species-specific antibacterial activity against 34 pathogens.
uncertainties: APEX model details (architecture, code, dataset) require full-text verification of the original paper (Wan, Torres, et al. 2024).
